business_model.claim: CoreCivic sells corrections, detention, residential reentry and government real estate solutions. Its customers are mainly federal, state and local government agencies. Federal authorities (ICE, USMS and BOP) paid 54% of total revenue in 2025.
quotes: Our customers primarily consist of federal, state, and local government agencies.
Payments by federal correctional, detention and residential reentry authorities represented 54%, 51%, and 52% of our total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

At September 30, 2026 Residential operated 64 facilities, 56 of them owned or controlled via long-term lease, with design capacity of approximately 72,000 beds. Services provides mail order pharmacy to over 600 correctional facilities across 32 states, plus transportation and electronic monitoring. Properties holds facilities for lease to government agencies, with design capacity of approximately 8,000 beds.

Through our CoreCivic Services segment, we provided mail order pharmacy services to over 600 correctional facilities
